dependencies.reason: Schema source of truth for contract-suite/1.0, test-gates/1.0, bundle-manifest/1.0.
Gate authoring rules, deterministic assertion types, and runtime harness interlock.
Blueprint authoring law and governance scanning delegation rules.
Canonical error envelope codes used by denial rules and CI failures.
Governance waivers and enforcement discipline for suite-wide scanners.
Suite lint and anti-drift rules; ATP-1 is an allowed governance scanner.
Tenant key naming invariant (org_id only) and hide-existence semantics used by bans.
Registry floor parity for Phase-5 Airlock.

domain_invariants.rationale: Prevents enforcement theater and repo-wide scan drift outside governance control.
domain_invariants.text: ATP-1 MUST be the only governance-owned contract permitted to define repo-wide anti-pattern scanning rules; subsystem contracts MUST NOT introduce repo scanning gates.

domain_invariants.rationale: Ensures reproducible enforcement and prevents accidental CI blow-ups.
domain_invariants.text: Scanner scope MUST be a bounded explicit path list and MUST be deterministic; whole-repo default scanning is forbidden.

domain_invariants.rationale: Prevents tenancy key drift that undermines isolation and telemetry invariants.
domain_invariants.text: Scanner bans MUST treat tenant_id and account_id as hard-banned keys; org_id is the only permitted tenant key.

domain_invariants.rationale: Eliminates non-deterministic, non-enforceable placeholders in canonical governance bundles.
domain_invariants.text: Placeholder tokens TODO|TBD|FIXME|REPLACEME are forbidden in lockable artifacts.
Authorization bypass patterns (authorize? false) are forbidden in production code paths.

domain_invariants.rationale: Prevents tenant leakage across pooled connections.
domain_invariants.text: Per-request session-wide SET patterns for tenant context are forbidden; tenant context must be transaction-local and connection-local.

scope.notes: Paths MUST be bounded and explicit; whole-repo implicit scanning is forbidden.

summary: Defines the governance-owned deterministic scanner used to enforce suite-wide anti-pattern bans and lockability constraints without allowing subsystem contracts to perform repo-wide scanning.
title: Governance Anti-Pattern Scanner Contract
